patients.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient; all rows with the same subject_id pertain to the same individual.
patients.gender: The genotypical sex of the patient.
patients.anchor_age: The patient's age in the anchor_year (set to 91 if the patient was over 89).
patients.anchor_year: A deidentified (shifted) year for the patient.
patients.anchor_year_group: A range of years during which the patient's true anchor_year occurred.
patients.dod: The de-identified date of death for the patient, sourced from hospital and state vital records.

admissions.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient; links to the patients table.
admissions.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
admissions.admittime: Date and time the patient was admitted to the hospital.
admissions.dischtime: Date and time the patient was discharged from the hospital.
admissions.deathtime: Time of in-hospital death, present only if the patient died during the hospitalization.
admissions.admission_type: Classifies the urgency of the admission (e.g. ELECTIVE, URGENT, EW EMER.).
admissions.admit_provider_id: Anonymous identifier for the provider who admitted the patient.
admissions.admission_location: The location of the patient prior to arriving at the hospital.
admissions.discharge_location: The disposition of the patient after discharge from the hospital.
admissions.insurance: Patient insurance information for the given hospitalization.
admissions.language: Patient language for the given hospitalization.
admissions.marital_status: Patient marital status for the given hospitalization.
admissions.race: Patient race/ethnicity for the given hospitalization.
admissions.edregtime: Date and time the patient was registered in the emergency department.
admissions.edouttime: Date and time the patient was discharged from the emergency department.
admissions.hospital_expire_flag: Binary flag indicating whether the patient died during the hospitalization (1 = died, 0 = survived).

transfers.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
transfers.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
transfers.transfer_id: Identifier unique to a single patient physical location.
transfers.eventtype: The type of transfer event (ed, admit, transfer, or discharge).
transfers.careunit: The type of unit or ward in which the patient is physically located.
transfers.intime: Date and time the patient was transferred into the current care unit.
transfers.outtime: Date and time the patient was transferred out of the current physical location.

services.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
services.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
services.transfertime: Time at which the patient moved from the prev_service to the curr_service.
services.prev_service: The previous hospital service the patient resided under.
services.curr_service: The current hospital service the patient resides under.

drgcodes.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
drgcodes.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
drgcodes.drg_type: The specific DRG ontology used for the code.
drgcodes.description: A description for the given DRG code.
drgcodes.drg_severity: The DRG-qualified patient severity of illness, if available.
drgcodes.drg_mortality: The DRG-qualified likelihood of patient mortality, if available.

diagnoses_icd.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
diagnoses_icd.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
diagnoses_icd.seq_num: The priority assigned to the diagnosis, interpretable as a ranking of importance.
diagnoses_icd.icd_code: The International Classification of Diseases (ICD) diagnosis code.
diagnoses_icd.icd_version: The ICD coding version, either 9 (ICD-9) or 10 (ICD-10).

d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code: The International Classification of Diseases (ICD) diagnosis code.
d_icd_diagnoses.icd_version: The ICD coding version, either 9 (ICD-9) or 10 (ICD-10).
d_icd_diagnoses.long_title: The textual meaning/definition of the ICD diagnosis code.

procedures_icd.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
procedures_icd.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
procedures_icd.seq_num: An assigned priority for procedures occurring within the hospital stay.
procedures_icd.chartdate: The date of the associated procedure.
procedures_icd.icd_code: The International Classification of Diseases (ICD) procedure code.
procedures_icd.icd_version: The ICD coding version, either 9 (ICD-9) or 10 (ICD-10).

d_icd_procedures.icd_code: The International Classification of Diseases (ICD) procedure code.
d_icd_procedures.icd_version: The ICD coding version, either 9 (ICD-9) or 10 (ICD-10).
d_icd_procedures.long_title: A brief textual definition for the given procedure code.

labevents.labevent_id: An integer unique for every row in the table.
labevents.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
labevents.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
labevents.specimen_id: Identifier grouping lab measurements made on the same patient-derived specimen.
labevents.itemid: Identifier uniquely denoting the laboratory concept being measured.
labevents.order_provider_id: Anonymous identifier for the provider who ordered the laboratory measurement.
labevents.charttime: The time at which the laboratory measurement was charted (usually specimen acquisition time).
labevents.storetime: The time at which the measurement was made available in the laboratory system.
labevents.value: The result of the laboratory measurement.
labevents.valuenum: The laboratory result cast as a numeric data type, if numeric.
labevents.valueuom: The unit of measurement for the laboratory concept.
labevents.ref_range_lower: The lower bound of the normal reference range for the measurement.
labevents.ref_range_upper: The upper bound of the normal reference range for the measurement.
labevents.flag: A brief string mainly used to indicate if the laboratory measurement is abnormal.
labevents.priority: The priority of the laboratory measurement: either routine or stat (urgent).
labevents.comments: Deidentified free-text comments associated with the laboratory measurement.

d_labitems.itemid: A unique identifier for a laboratory concept, used to link to labevents.
d_labitems.label: Describes the concept represented by the itemid.
d_labitems.fluid: The substance (e.g. blood, urine) on which the measurement was made.
d_labitems.category: Higher-level information on the type of measurement (e.g. ABG).

prescriptions.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
prescriptions.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
prescriptions.pharmacy_id: Identifier linking the prescription to pharmacy information and eMAR administrations.
prescriptions.poe_id: Identifier linking the prescription to an associated order in the poe table.
prescriptions.poe_seq: Sequence number linking the prescription to an associated order in the poe table.
prescriptions.order_provider_id: Anonymous identifier for the provider who initiated the order.
prescriptions.starttime: The prescribed start time for the medication.
prescriptions.stoptime: The prescribed stop time for the medication.
prescriptions.drug_type: The component of the prescription the drug occupies (MAIN, BASE, or ADDITIVE).
prescriptions.drug: A free-text description of the medication administered.
prescriptions.formulary_drug_cd: A hospital-specific ontology code used to order drugs from the formulary.
prescriptions.gsn: The Generic Sequence Number (GSN), a coded identifier for medications.
prescriptions.ndc: The National Drug Code (NDC), a coded identifier uniquely identifying medications.
prescriptions.prod_strength: A free-text description of the composition of the prescribed medication.
prescriptions.form_rx: The container in which the formulary dose is delivered (e.g. TABLET, VIAL).
prescriptions.dose_val_rx: The prescribed dose intended to be administered over the given period.
prescriptions.dose_unit_rx: The unit of measurement for the dose.
prescriptions.form_val_disp: The amount of medication contained in a single formulary dose.
prescriptions.form_unit_disp: The unit of measurement for the formulary dose.
prescriptions.doses_per_24_hrs: The number of doses per 24 hours for which the medication is to be given.
prescriptions.route: The route of administration for the medication.

emar.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
emar.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
emar.emar_id: A unique identifier for each order made in eMAR (subject_id-emar_seq).
emar.emar_seq: A consecutive integer numbering eMAR orders chronologically.
emar.poe_id: Identifier linking the administration to orders in poe and prescriptions.
emar.pharmacy_id: Identifier linking the administration to pharmacy information.
emar.enter_provider_id: Anonymous identifier for the provider who entered the information into eMAR.
emar.charttime: The time at which the medication was administered.
emar.medication: The name of the medication which was administered.
emar.event_txt: Information about the administration (e.g. Administered, Not Given).
emar.scheduletime: If present, the time at which the administration was scheduled.
emar.storetime: The time at which the administration was documented in the eMAR table.

emar_detail.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
emar_detail.emar_id: A unique identifier for each order made in eMAR (subject_id-emar_seq).
emar_detail.emar_seq: A consecutive integer numbering eMAR orders chronologically.
emar_detail.parent_field_ordinal: Delineates multiple formulary administrations belonging to the same eMAR event.
emar_detail.administration_type: The type of administration (e.g. IV Bolus, IV Infusion, Transdermal Patch).
emar_detail.pharmacy_id: Identifier linking the eMAR order to pharmacy information.
emar_detail.barcode_type: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.reason_for_no_barcode: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.complete_dose_not_given: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.dose_due: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.dose_due_unit: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.dose_given: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.dose_given_unit: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.will_remainder_of_dose_be_given: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.product_amount_given: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.product_unit: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.product_code: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.product_description: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.product_description_other: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.prior_infusion_rate: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.infusion_rate: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.infusion_rate_adjustment: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.infusion_rate_adjustment_amount: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.infusion_rate_unit: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.route: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.infusion_complete: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.completion_interval: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.new_iv_bag_hung: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.continued_infusion_in_other_location: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.restart_interval: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.side: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.site: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.
emar_detail.non_formulary_visual_verification: Information about the delivery of the formulary dose of the administered medication.

poe.poe_id: A unique identifier for the given order (subject_id-poe_seq).
poe.poe_seq: A monotonically increasing integer chronologically sorting the POE orders.
poe.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
poe.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
poe.ordertime: The date and time at which the provider order was made.
poe.order_type: The type of provider order (e.g. Medications, Lab, Radiology, Consults).
poe.order_subtype: Further detail on the type of order, best interpreted alongside order_type.
poe.transaction_type: The action the provider performed for this order (e.g. New, Change, D/C).
poe.discontinue_of_poe_id: If this order discontinues a previous order, links to that discontinued order.
poe.discontinued_by_poe_id: If this order was later discontinued, links to the discontinuing order.
poe.order_provider_id: Anonymous identifier for the provider who made the order.
poe.order_status: Whether the order is still Active or has been made Inactive.

poe_detail.poe_id: A unique identifier for the given order (subject_id-poe_seq).
poe_detail.poe_seq: A monotonically increasing integer chronologically sorting the POE orders.
poe_detail.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
poe_detail.field_name: The name of the particular aspect of the POE order this row describes.
poe_detail.field_value: The value associated with the given POE order and field_name.

microbiologyevents.microevent_id: A unique integer denoting the row.
microbiologyevents.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
microbiologyevents.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
microbiologyevents.micro_specimen_id: Identifier grouping microbiology measurements made on the same specimen.
microbiologyevents.order_provider_id: Anonymous identifier for the provider who ordered the microbiology test.
microbiologyevents.chartdate: The date of the measurement (always available; date-only proxy of charttime).
microbiologyevents.charttime: The time at which the observation was charted (closest proxy to measurement time).
microbiologyevents.spec_itemid: Identifier for the specimen tested for bacterial growth.
microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc: Description of the specimen tested (e.g. blood, urine, sputum).
microbiologyevents.test_seq: Delineates multiple samples drawn for the same specimen.
microbiologyevents.storedate: The date when the microbiology result was available.
microbiologyevents.storetime: The date and time when the microbiology result was available.
microbiologyevents.test_itemid: Identifier for the test performed on the given specimen.
microbiologyevents.test_name: Name of the test performed on the given specimen.
microbiologyevents.org_itemid: Identifier for the organism that grew when tested; NULL if no growth.
microbiologyevents.org_name: Name of the organism that grew when tested; NULL if a negative culture.
microbiologyevents.isolate_num: For antibiotic testing, the isolated colony number (starts at 1).
microbiologyevents.ab_itemid: Identifier for the antibiotic tested against the organism for sensitivity.
microbiologyevents.ab_name: Name of the antibiotic tested against the organism for sensitivity.
microbiologyevents.dilution_text: Dilution value (text) from antibiotic sensitivity testing.
microbiologyevents.dilution_comparison: The comparison operator for the dilution value in sensitivity testing.
microbiologyevents.dilution_value: The numeric dilution value from antibiotic sensitivity testing.
microbiologyevents.interpretation: Interpretation of antibiotic sensitivity (S=sensitive, R=resistant, I=intermediate, P=pending).
microbiologyevents.comments: Deidentified free-text comments associated with the microbiology measurement.

icustays.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
icustays.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
icustays.stay_id: Generated identifier uniquely specifying a single ICU stay.
icustays.first_careunit: The first ICU type in which the patient was cared for during the stay.
icustays.last_careunit: The last ICU type in which the patient was cared for during the stay.
icustays.intime: Date and time the patient was transferred into the ICU.
icustays.outtime: Date and time the patient was transferred out of the ICU.
icustays.los: The length of stay for the given ICU stay, measured in fractional days.

chartevents.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
chartevents.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
chartevents.stay_id: Integer uniquely identifying a single ICU stay.
chartevents.caregiver_id: Uniquely identifies the caregiver who documented the data.
chartevents.charttime: The time at which the observation was made (closest proxy to measurement time).
chartevents.storetime: The time at which the observation was manually input or validated by clinical staff.
chartevents.itemid: Identifier for a single measurement type in the database.
chartevents.value: The value measured for the concept identified by the itemid.
chartevents.valuenum: The measured value in numeric format, if numeric; otherwise null.
chartevents.valueuom: The unit of measurement for the value, if appropriate.
chartevents.warning: Specifies if a warning for this observation was manually documented by the care provider.

d_items.itemid: A unique identifier for an ICU measurement concept (alternate primary key).
d_items.label: Describes the concept represented by the itemid.
d_items.abbreviation: A common abbreviation for the label (Metavision only).
d_items.linksto: The event table name which the itemid's data links to (e.g. chartevents).
d_items.category: Information on the type of data the itemid corresponds to (e.g. ABG, IV Medication).
d_items.unitname: The unit of measurement used for the itemid, when available.
d_items.param_type: The type of data recorded: a date, a number, or a text field.
d_items.lownormalvalue: The lower bound of the expected reference range for the measurement.
d_items.highnormalvalue: The upper bound of the expected reference range for the measurement.

inputevents.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
inputevents.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
inputevents.stay_id: Integer uniquely identifying a single ICU stay.
inputevents.caregiver_id: Uniquely identifies the caregiver who documented the data.
inputevents.starttime: The start time of the input event.
inputevents.endtime: The end time of the input event.
inputevents.storetime: The time at which the observation was manually input or validated by clinical staff.
inputevents.itemid: Identifier for a single measurement type in the database (e.g. norepinephrine).
inputevents.amount: The amount of a drug or substance administered to the patient.
inputevents.amountuom: The unit of measurement for the amount administered.
inputevents.rate: The rate at which the drug or substance was administered.
inputevents.rateuom: The unit of measurement for the rate of administration.
inputevents.orderid: Links multiple items contained in the same solution together.
inputevents.linkorderid: Links the same order across multiple instantiations (e.g. rate changes).
inputevents.ordercategoryname: Higher-level information about the order, representing the type of administration.
inputevents.secondaryordercategoryname: Higher-level secondary category information about the order.
inputevents.ordercomponenttypedescription: Describes the role of the substance in the solution (main, additive, or mixed).
inputevents.ordercategorydescription: Higher-level description of the order's administration type.
inputevents.totalamount: The total amount of fluid in the bag containing the solution.
inputevents.totalamountuom: The unit of measurement for the total amount of fluid in the bag.
inputevents.isopenbag: Whether the order was from an open bag.
inputevents.continueinnextdept: If the order ended on transfer, whether it continued into the next department.
inputevents.statusdescription: The ultimate status of the row indicating why delivery ended (e.g. Changed, Stopped).
inputevents.originalamount: The amount of the drug contained in the bag at starttime.
inputevents.originalrate: The rate input by the care provider (the originally planned rate).

outputevents.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
outputevents.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
outputevents.stay_id: Integer uniquely identifying a single ICU stay.
outputevents.caregiver_id: Uniquely identifies the caregiver who documented the data.
outputevents.charttime: The time of an output event.
outputevents.storetime: The time at which the observation was manually input or validated by clinical staff.
outputevents.itemid: Identifier for a single measurement type in the database.
outputevents.value: The amount of a substance at the charttime.
outputevents.valueuom: The unit of measurement for the value.

procedureevents.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
procedureevents.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
procedureevents.stay_id: Integer uniquely identifying a single ICU stay.
procedureevents.caregiver_id: Uniquely identifies the caregiver who documented the data.
procedureevents.starttime: The start time of the procedure event.
procedureevents.endtime: The end time of the procedure event.
procedureevents.storetime: The time when the event was recorded in the system.
procedureevents.itemid: Identifier for a single procedure type in the database (links to d_items).
procedureevents.value: The duration of the procedure, if applicable.
procedureevents.valueuom: The unit of measurement for the value (e.g. min, hour, day, or None).
procedureevents.location: Where on the patient's body the procedure took place.
procedureevents.locationcategory: Higher-level category of the procedure location.
procedureevents.orderid: Links the procedure to a specific physician order.
procedureevents.linkorderid: Links repeated procedures performed under the same original order.
procedureevents.ordercategoryname: Higher-level information about the order, representing the type of administration.
procedureevents.ordercategorydescription: Higher-level description of the order's administration type.
procedureevents.isopenbag: Whether the order was from an open bag.
procedureevents.continueinnextdept: If the order ended on transfer, whether it continued into the next department.
procedureevents.statusdescription: The ultimate status of the procedure (e.g. FinishedRunning, Stopped, Paused).
procedureevents.originalamount: Present and never null but has no clear meaning.
procedureevents.originalrate: Present and never null but has no clear meaning (either 0 or 1 for all records).

edstays.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
edstays.hadm_id: Hospital identifier if the patient was admitted after their ED stay; NULL otherwise.
edstays.stay_id: An identifier which uniquely identifies a single emergency department stay.
edstays.intime: The admission datetime of the emergency department stay.
edstays.outtime: The discharge datetime of the emergency department stay.
edstays.gender: The patient's administrative gender as documented in the hospital system.
edstays.race: The patient's self-reported race, aggregated for very small groups.
edstays.arrival_transport: The method through which the individual arrived at the ED (e.g. WALK IN, AMBULANCE).
edstays.disposition: The method through which the individual left the ED (e.g. HOME, ADMITTED, TRANSFER).

ed_triage.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
ed_triage.stay_id: An identifier which uniquely identifies a single emergency department stay.
ed_triage.temperature: The patient's temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (some may be in Celsius).
ed_triage.heartrate: The patient's heart rate in beats per minute.
ed_triage.resprate: The patient's respiratory rate in breaths per minute.
ed_triage.o2sat: The patient's peripheral oxygen saturation as a percentage.
ed_triage.sbp: The patient's systolic blood pressure in mmHg.
ed_triage.dbp: The patient's diastolic blood pressure in mmHg.
ed_triage.pain: The level of pain self-reported by the patient on a scale of 0-10.
ed_triage.acuity: Priority based on the Emergency Severity Index (1 = highest, 5 = lowest), assigned by a nurse.
ed_triage.chiefcomplaint: A deidentified free-text description of the patient's chief complaint.

ed_vitalsign.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
ed_vitalsign.stay_id: An identifier which uniquely identifies a single emergency department stay.
ed_vitalsign.charttime: The time at which the vital signs were charted.
ed_vitalsign.temperature: The patient's temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (some may be in Celsius).
ed_vitalsign.heartrate: The patient's heart rate in beats per minute.
ed_vitalsign.resprate: The patient's respiratory rate in breaths per minute.
ed_vitalsign.o2sat: The patient's oxygen saturation as a percentage.
ed_vitalsign.sbp: The patient's systolic blood pressure in mmHg.
ed_vitalsign.dbp: The patient's diastolic blood pressure in mmHg.
ed_vitalsign.pain: The patient's self-reported level of pain on a scale of 0-10 (free-text).

ed_diagnosis.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
ed_diagnosis.stay_id: An identifier which uniquely identifies a single emergency department stay.
ed_diagnosis.seq_num: A pseudo-priority for the diagnosis (1 usually indicates a primary diagnosis).
ed_diagnosis.icd_code: A coded diagnosis using the International Classification of Diseases (ICD) ontology.
ed_diagnosis.icd_version: The version of the ICD system used, either 9 (ICD-9) or 10 (ICD-10).
ed_diagnosis.icd_title: The textual description of the diagnosis.

ed_pyxis.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
ed_pyxis.stay_id: An identifier which uniquely identifies a single emergency department stay.
ed_pyxis.charttime: The time the medication was charted (closest approximation to administration time).
ed_pyxis.med_rn: A row number for the medicine used to group single dispensations.
ed_pyxis.name: The name of the medicine.
ed_pyxis.gsn_rn: A row number differentiating multiple GSN groups for a single medicine.
ed_pyxis.gsn: The Generic Sequence Number (GSN) code for the medicine.

medrecon.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
medrecon.stay_id: An identifier which uniquely identifies a single emergency department stay.
medrecon.charttime: The time at which the medicine reconciliation was charted.
medrecon.name: The name of the medication.
medrecon.gsn: The Generic Sequence Number (GSN) code for the medication.
medrecon.ndc: The National Drug Code (NDC) for the medication.
medrecon.etc_rn: A sequential integer differentiating Enhanced Therapeutic Class (ETC) groups for the medication.
medrecon.etccode: The Enhanced Therapeutic Class (ETC) group code for the medication.
medrecon.etcdescription: The description of the Enhanced Therapeutic Class (ETC) group.

discharge_notes.note_id: A unique identifier for the note (subject_id-note_type-note_seq).
discharge_notes.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
discharge_notes.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
discharge_notes.note_type: The type of note (DS = discharge summary, AD = discharge summary addendum).
discharge_notes.note_seq: A monotonically increasing integer chronologically sorting notes within a note_type.
discharge_notes.charttime: The time at which the note was charted (most relevant time for interpreting content).
discharge_notes.storetime: The time at which the note was stored, usually when completed and signed.
discharge_notes.text: The free-text content of the discharge note.

discharge_detail.note_id: A unique identifier for the note (subject_id-note_type-note_seq).
discharge_detail.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
discharge_detail.field_name: The name of the particular aspect of the note this row describes (e.g. author).
discharge_detail.field_value: The value associated with the given field_name for the note.
discharge_detail.field_ordinal: Sequential ordinal for the field within the note.

radiology_notes.note_id: A unique identifier for the note (subject_id-note_type-note_seq).
radiology_notes.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
radiology_notes.hadm_id: Integer identifier unique for each patient hospitalization.
radiology_notes.note_type: The type of note (RR = radiology report, AR = radiology report addendum).
radiology_notes.note_seq: A monotonically increasing integer chronologically sorting notes within a note_type.
radiology_notes.charttime: The time at which the note was charted (most relevant time for interpreting content).
radiology_notes.storetime: The time at which the note was stored, usually when completed and signed.
radiology_notes.text: The free-text content of the radiology report.

radiology_detail.note_id: A unique identifier for the note (subject_id-note_type-note_seq).
radiology_detail.subject_id: Unique identifier specifying an individual patient.
radiology_detail.field_name: The name of the aspect of the note this row describes (e.g. cpt_code, exam_name).
radiology_detail.field_value: The value associated with the given field_name for the note.
radiology_detail.field_ordinal: Sequential ordinal for the field within the note.
